name: retro-future
vibe: An 80s synthwave / outrun film. A persistent, continuously-scrolling neon world — a gradient sunset sky, a twinkling starfield, a banded neon sun sitting on the horizon, an infinite neon perspective grid rushing to the vanishing point, a glowing horizon line and CRT scanlines — flows unbroken across every cut. Chrome/neon italic display headlines ignite over the grid; screenshots ride inside neon-bordered CRT/arcade cabinets; a radiating light-burst climax blooms; a blinking 'Press Start' logo-reveal CTA closes. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole world — the sky tint, the neon grid, the sun and horizon glow, the CRT borders, the chrome type accent and the CTA, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for bold, nostalgic, electric launches, gaming/creator/AI products, hype reels and anything that should feel retro-futuristic and neon.
